NOT a list of things to fix: a register is an approved concept demo, and Kenny's rule of 2026-09-08 (S49) is that a test which says a demo must change produces a finding for him, never a silent correction. So this file is the finding, with the measurement, and the suite refuses any overflow it does not already name. The document itself scrolls sideways in NO theme, in neither channel, at neither width -- SC 1.4.10 holds everywhere; what is recorded here is the package's own stricter rule, an element wider than the box that holds it.
how: Keyed by theme and by the element the audit named, with the state classes (is-*) stripped, because a headline caught mid-reveal carries a different one in each browser. A value of null means that browser did not reproduce it: the pixels are small enough that the two engines disagree, which is itself part of the finding. The suite checks one direction only -- an overflow this file does not name is red -- because an entry that one engine reproduces and the other does not could never pass a stale check in both.
